title: Four Wheels
html:

  • 3. Sattivagga 3. A Sword

Catucakkasutta Four Wheels

“Catucakkaṁ navadvāraṁ, “Four are its wheels, and nine its doors; puṇṇaṁ lobhena saṁyutaṁ; it’s stuffed full, bound with greed, Paṅkajātaṁ mahāvīra, and born from a bog. kathaṁ yātrā bhavissatī”ti. Great hero, how will I keep going?”

“Chetvā naddhiṁ varattañca, “Having cut the strap and harness— icchā lobhañca pāpakaṁ; the wicked desire and greed— Samūlaṁ taṇhamabbuyha, and having plucked out craving, root and all: evaṁ yātrā bhavissatī”ti. that’s how you will keep going.”
